defects.issue: Plan & billing lists '6-year incident archive' as included, yet Compliance says 'the archive is off' and the to-do list asks the owner to turn it on. An owner reads this as paying for something that isn't switched on.
defects.fix: Turn the archive on by default for HIPAA tenants, or label it 'included, needs your OK to enable (1 click)' and give it a working toggle on Billing.

defects.issue: '+ 2 other alerts (agent tamper alert, confirmed safe)' and '4 escalated (2 real threats, agent tamper alert, confirmed safe)' read as if the tamper alert was confirmed safe. The tamper alert is still open.
defects.fix: Write '2 threats stopped · 1 open (agent removed on FRONTDESK-05) · 1 false alarm (svc-backup)'.

defects.issue: m.reyes is shown as having 'left Oct 7' (account unused, overdue disable) but also as 'moved to part-time contractor', and she uninstalled the agent on Nov 9 as a local admin. The owner can't tell whether a former employee is still on the network.
defects.fix: Pick one story. If she is a contractor, show her current role and access. If she left, make the Nov 9 removal a high-severity insider incident and put it first.

defects.issue: The headline names FRONTDESK-05 twice: 'reinstall agent' and again inside 'reconnect 4 silent devices'.
defects.fix: Say 'reconnect the other 3 silent devices'.

defects.issue: 'Per year $11,988 vs cyber premium $6,840/yr' compares two unrelated costs.
defects.fix: Compare against something relevant: the premium saving estimate, a typical in-house SOC cost, or the policy retention.

defects.issue: Her own incident (reception@ password) opens with a full legal block: HIPAA 4-factor, state-law deadlines, evidence list. She is the person who 'gets alerts she doesn't understand'.
defects.fix: For the office role, collapse breach assessment into one line ('No patient data exposed. Nothing to report.') with a 'details for counsel' disclosure.

defects.issue: The Overview is identical to the owner's: 4 urgent, 3 of them for IT. Her one task is not singled out on the home screen. Only the notifications popover filters to 'Mine'.
defects.fix: Add a 'Your tasks (1)' strip at the top of the Overview for the office role, and use 'You' instead of 'Office manager' on her items.

defects.issue: The question thread promises a 'reply due by 14:35 (15-minute promise)', but the published promise covers high alerts, not questions.
defects.fix: State a separate SLA for questions, or word it 'usually within 15 minutes'.

defects.issue: Agent removed by m.reyes (marked as left Oct 7) on a patient-data PC is rated Medium, and the action says 'Ask m.reyes why'. An IT manager would treat a leaver with local admin uninstalling EDR as high.
defects.fix: Raise it to High, link it to the overdue leaver record, and make the action 'disable account and local admin now; reinstall agent'.

defects.issue: Noise reduction is only a total (1,240 → 4). There are no top noisy rules, suppressions or tuning changes, which is what 'fewer false alarms' needs.
defects.fix: Add a 'Top 5 alert sources and what analysts tuned' table on Incidents for IT and MSP roles.

defects.issue: 'Evidence behind this conclusion' is the same 4-line template on every incident, e.g. an endpoint process tree for a Microsoft 365 sign-in attack.
defects.fix: List the evidence actually used for each incident.

defects.issue: Sunrise CU has an open impossible-travel sign-in after an approved MFA prompt (a likely account takeover). Its status still reads 'Protected on 117 of 120 devices' and NCUA/GLBA shows '8 of 8 evidenced controls met'.
defects.fix: While an account-compromise incident is open, status should be 'Action needed', and the affected controls should drop to partly met.

defects.issue: Harbor's evidence list mentions the 'practice-management server', which is dental template text on a car dealer.
defects.fix: Use evidence sources specific to each client and incident (DMS, M365 audit log).

defects.issue: The forwarding rule was created Nov 9 19:02 and the alert fired Nov 11 08:12 (37 h later), yet the incident shows 'contained in 18 min'. An MSP tech will question why rule creation wasn't caught.
defects.fix: Show dwell time honestly ('rule active 37 h before detection'), or make detection near the creation time.

defects.issue: The queue has no age or SLA timer and no 'waiting on client vs analyst' owner per open item.
defects.fix: Add 'Waiting on' and 'age/SLA' columns.

defects.issue: Harbor's to-do says 'Disable 1 account … Office manager'. Template role text.
defects.fix: Use the client's real contact (Greg Holt / Northwind IT).

defects.issue: The 'Alerts/day, 30D' column is an unlabeled sparkline with no number or scale, so it can't support a cost-to-serve decision.
defects.fix: Show the average per day next to each sparkline, e.g. '77/day'.

defects.issue: Kline & Ortiz is flagged 'At risk: renews in 50 days' only because a renewal is near. That isn't a risk signal.
defects.fix: Separate 'Renewal soon' from 'At risk', and give a reason when it is at risk.

defects.issue: HIPAA §164.308(a)(1)(ii)(A) Risk analysis is shown as 'Met' among controls 'Watchpost collects evidence for'. An MDR can't evidence a risk analysis; it is a customer document.
defects.fix: Label each control's evidence source (Watchpost-collected vs customer-uploaded vs attested), and mark risk analysis 'Customer document · uploaded Mar 2'.

defects.issue: The FTC Safeguards view marks 314.4(c)(3) 'Encrypt customer information' Met and 314.4(j) 'Notify the FTC' Met while a possible notifiable event is under review. Neither can be evidenced by log collection.
defects.fix: Mark (c)(3) as customer-attested. Show (j) as 'Process in place · decision due Nov 13' rather than Met.

defects.issue: The 6-year archive is off on every HIPAA tenant even though it is listed as included. Compliance would expect it on by default.
defects.fix: Default it on for HIPAA tenants.

defects.issue: Sunrise shows NCUA/GLBA 8 of 8 met despite an open account compromise and missing critical updates.
defects.fix: Tie control status to open findings.

defects.issue: There is no view tying spend to outcome: the $11,988/yr cost against the expected premium change and the $25k retention exposure.
defects.fix: Add a small 'Cost vs value' card on Billing: premium estimate delta, retention avoided, plus a tax/receipt export.

defects.issue: 'vs cyber premium' comparison on Billing is confusing.
defects.fix: Remove it or reword it as a value comparison.

defects.issue: The 'Client-safe view' meant for showing clients still lists all 6 clients' names, prices and internal 'At risk: no QBR since…' notes. Showing it to one client leaks other clients and internal judgments.
defects.fix: Client-safe mode should show only the selected client, with no risk notes.

defects.issue: The QBR compares 'Q4 2026 (to date)' (6 weeks) with all of Q3 and shows down arrows on threats and alerts. That misleads the client.
defects.fix: Normalise per month or compare equal periods; mark the quarter as partial.

defects.issue: QBR wording is sloppy: 'Coverage … ▲ vs Q3 (98)' is missing the % sign, and '($2/device/mo ($82/mo))' has nested parentheses. A readiness assessment priced per month is also odd.
defects.fix: Write 'vs Q3 (98%)' and 'CMMC L2 readiness: $82/mo ($2/device)' or price it as one-off.

defects.issue: Mia Reyes is a leaver ('left Oct 7', overdue 35 days) and also 'moved to part-time contractor'. The manager can't tell whether to disable her.
defects.fix: Model a role change: contractor account kept with reduced rights, old employee account disabled.

defects.issue: Overdue removals (42 and 35 days) only offer 'Request disable' with a 1-business-day SLA. There is no escalation or proof of when access was actually removed.
defects.fix: Show an escalation path and a dated 'access removed' confirmation that feeds compliance.

defects.issue: CMMC PE/MP controls (physical access, visitor logs, media sanitisation) show '✓ Met' like Watchpost-collected controls, even though the text says the company attests them. The auditor can't tell which evidence has provenance.
defects.fix: Add an evidence-source column (Collected by Watchpost · date / Company attestation · signer · date).

defects.issue: The Ridgeline incident's 'Evidence' cites the 'practice-management server' (dental template). The auditor will distrust the record.
defects.fix: Use evidence specific to the incident.

defects.issue: Audit dates show the last self-assessment as Apr 2, 2026 and the next as Dec 8, 2026. That is not annual, and nothing explains it.
defects.fix: Label Dec 8 as the prime's supplier review, and show the next SPRS affirmation separately.

defects.issue: The 36-month history only gives severity counts, with no year-by-year split or list of events. Underwriters ask 'any incidents in the last 3 years, describe'.
defects.fix: Add an expandable per-year list with one-line descriptions and outcomes.

defects.issue: The attestation is signed today but covers answers that are 'Partly'. It's unclear what exactly is attested.
defects.fix: Show the attestation text, or the scope per question.

defects.issue: On the agent-removal incident, 'Patient data accessed: No' is based on telemetry before the removal. There is no visibility after 16:12, and the person removing it is recorded as a leaver. Counsel would not accept 'No'.
defects.fix: Show 'Unknown after Nov 9 16:12 (no telemetry)' and an open assessment with a decision date.

defects.issue: The 4-factor row 'Unauthorized person: See timeline' is a non-answer, and the evidence list is the same template on every incident.
defects.fix: Fill in the actual factor (e.g. 'unknown external actor, IPs 102.89.x.x') and the evidence actually reviewed.

defects.issue: Incident records are kept 12 months; the 6-year HIPAA documentation archive is off.
defects.fix: Default it on and show it on the incident record.

defects.issue: After 'I clicked a link', the verdict resets the password but says nothing about whether their PC was checked or whether to keep using it.
defects.fix: Add 'We checked your PC: clean, keep working' or an instruction.

defects.issue: 'Data location: US only' is followed by 'Analysts work from the US and India via a VDI'. For a credit union this is offshore access, and no India entity appears among subprocessors.
defects.fix: Split 'storage location' from 'access locations', and list the India support entity or affiliate as a subprocessor with its controls.

defects.issue: Sunrise contracts through Northwind IT (MSP), but the trust page doesn't say who holds the contract or explain the fourth-party relationship.
defects.fix: Add a 'Contracting party: Northwind IT; Watchpost is Northwind's subprocessor' block, with flow-down terms.

defects.issue: Missing Watchpost's own breach-notification commitment to the customer (needed for NCUA 72-hour reporting), BC/DR (RTO/RPO) and staff background checks.
defects.fix: Add these three rows to the Trust page.

defects.issue: The training roster gives a count and 3 names, but no per-person completion date or certificate. That is what insurance and auditors ask for.
defects.fix: Add a roster table with name, course, date and certificate status.

defects.issue: '1 joiners' grammar, and the m.reyes leaver/contractor contradiction.
defects.fix: Fix pluralisation; model the role change.

defects.issue: Maple Insurance shows 'Renewal date Jan 1, 2027' while also saying 'No cyber policy yet'. The timeline puts 'Jan 5 underwriter questions' after the Jan 1 'renewal', and the breach-cost text reads 'retention (—)'.
defects.fix: For an entity with no policy, show 'Join group policy by Jan 1' with a correct timeline and hide retention.

defects.issue: No group view of what the group pays Watchpost per entity, and no board-ready export of the scorecard.
defects.fix: Add a cost column or total and a 'Download board pack (PDF)' action.

defects.issue: Maple's Overview, inherited by the group view, claims 'every device reported in' and an October report. See trial defects.
defects.fix: Fix as in trial.

defects.issue: The Overview says 'Quiet month: no threats needed action and every device reported in' while 7 of 38 devices have no agent.
defects.fix: For onboarding tenants, write '31 of 38 devices covered; 7 still to install'.

defects.issue: The Devices tab says 'Not reporting ✓ 0 devices · Every device here is reporting' and never lists the 7 missing devices.
defects.fix: Add a 'Not yet installed (7)' list built from the M365/AD device inventory, with names and the install link.

defects.issue: The Overview shows 'Last 30 days (Oct 12–Nov 11)' and offers an 'October 2026 report' for a customer who started around Nov 2.
defects.fix: Use 'Since Nov 2 (trial)' and replace the October report with the week-1 report.

defects.issue: The first invoice is Nov 16, but no price or plan is shown anywhere for the trial role (38 devices would be the $599 Small office plan), and go-live review is Nov 25, after billing starts.
defects.fix: Show 'After trial: Small office $599/mo, first invoice Nov 16, cancel anytime before', and align go-live review before the first invoice.

defects.issue: Two to-do items have no 'Open' link, and the Insurance and HIPAA cards have no destination because those tabs are not available to the trial role.
defects.fix: Make all items actionable or remove the links consistently.

global_defects.issue: 'Evidence behind this conclusion' is one fixed list on every incident for every client: dental 'practice-management server' text on a car dealer and a machine shop, and an endpoint process tree on M365-only incidents.
global_defects.fix: Generate the evidence list from each incident's data sources.

global_defects.issue: Status labels are not computed consistently: Sunrise is 'Protected … · 3 urgent' with an open account-takeover incident, while Harbor is 'Action needed'.
global_defects.fix: One rule: any open incident needing client action means 'Action needed'.

global_defects.issue: Compliance 'Met' doesn't distinguish Watchpost-collected evidence from customer documents or attestations.
global_defects.fix: Add an evidence-source and date column on every framework.

global_defects.issue: On phone, the client or location switch sits only in the hamburger drawer; the context line shows the client but isn't tappable.
global_defects.fix: Make the context line a tap target that opens the switcher.

missing_personas: MSP service desk / NOC lead (shift handover, SLA breaches)
Board member / investor receiving the quarterly security report
